note: DRAFT English strings for event_cards.json. Owner of game/data/strings/en.json should merge these (status draft).

card.storm_warning.body.text: The forecast shows a big storm rolling in tomorrow. The grounds crew asks what to do about the flags and tee markers.

card.storm_warning.a_out.text: The crew tied down every marker and cover. The storm passes with little damage.

card.storm_warning.b_out.text: Some markers blew across the fairways and members grumbled about the mess.

card.rainbow_after_shower.body.text: A double rainbow arcs over the ninth green after the shower. Golfers are stopping to take photos.

card.rainbow_after_shower.a_out.text: Your photo goes round the local groups. A few curious golfers come out to see it.

card.rainbow_after_shower.b_out.text: Rounds run on time and nobody is delayed.

card.heatwave.body.text: Temperatures are soaring. Golfers are wilting and the greens are drying out fast.

card.heatwave.a_out.text: Cold water at every tee keeps golfers happy. It costs a bit.

card.heatwave.b_out.text: The greens stay lush but the water bill climbs.

card.heatwave.c_out.text: Tired golfers cut their rounds short.

card.cool_breeze.body.text: Blue skies, light breeze, and not a cloud in sight. Everyone wants to play today.

card.cool_breeze.a_out.text: More tee times means more golfers on the course.

card.cool_breeze.b_out.text: Golfers enjoy an unhurried round and say so on the way out.

card.morning_fog.body.text: Fog is hanging over the fairways. Golfers cannot see the flags from the tee.

card.morning_fog.a_out.text: The fog lifts by mid morning. A few golfers go home.

card.morning_fog.b_out.text: Some shots vanish into the mist. Golfers find it funny and mostly stay cheerful.

card.frost_delay.body.text: A hard frost has turned the fairways white and crunchy.

card.frost_delay.a_out.text: The frost melts by noon. The first hours are quiet.

card.frost_delay.b_out.text: A small crew clears the worst spots and play starts on time.

card.windy_day.body.text: Gusts are blowing hats across the practice green. Scores are creeping up.

card.windy_day.a_out.text: The pro shop gives out a tip card. Golfers love it.

card.windy_day.b_out.text: Golfers blame the wind and take it in good humour.

card.surprise_snow.body.text: A light snowfall has covered the course overnight. Kids in the neighbourhood are out with sledges.

card.surprise_snow.a_out.text: The community loves it. Nobody plays golf, but everyone talks about it.

card.surprise_snow.b_out.text: The crew clears paths and the club stays tidy.

card.flooded_bunkers.body.text: The rain has filled the bunkers. A few ducks have moved in and are swimming happily.

card.flooded_bunkers.a_out.text: The crew pumps the bunkers dry and the ducks move to the pond.

card.flooded_bunkers.b.text: Declare them water hazards for the day

card.flooded_bunkers.b_out.text: Golfers love the joke and the ducks have a splendid afternoon.

card.dry_spell_brown.body.text: It has not rained for weeks and the fairways are turning golden brown.

card.dry_spell_brown.a_out.text: The fairways green up again. It is not cheap.

card.dry_spell_brown.b_out.text: Golfers get extra roll and enjoy the bounce. A few complain.

card.lightning_scare.body.text: Distant thunder is rumbling. The horn blew and everyone is sheltering in the clubhouse.

card.lightning_scare.a.text: Open the snack bar for the wait

card.lightning_scare.a_out.text: Golfers buy snacks while the storm passes.

card.lightning_scare.b_out.text: Golfers are happy and come back another day.

card.vip_visit.body.text: A well known local business owner wants to play a round at your course and is looking for a great experience.

card.vip_visit.a_out.text: The VIP loves the day and tells everyone about it.

card.golf_writer.body.text: A writer for the fictional Fairway Gazette is visiting to write a piece on hidden gem courses.

card.golf_writer.a_out.text: She loves the tour and the article is warm.

card.golf_writer.b_out.text: She plays a quiet round and writes a short, fair note.

card.sponsor_scout.body.text: A scout for Birdie Bolt Sports Drink is checking out courses for a local sponsorship.

card.sponsor_scout.a_out.text: The scout likes the pitch. A small sponsorship payment arrives.

card.sponsor_scout.b_out.text: The scout enjoys the range. Golfers see the banner and stop by.

card.junior_champion.body.text: A local junior champion wants to play a round and sign a few autographs.

card.junior_champion.a_out.text: Kids and parents line up. Everyone goes home smiling.

card.junior_champion.b_out.text: The champion has a great round and leaves a nice comment.

card.mayor_round.body.text: The mayor has booked a round with two guests and asks about the view from the clubhouse.

card.mayor_round.a_out.text: Lunch goes very well. The mayor mentions your club in a speech.

card.tourist_group.body.text: A tour bus has pulled up with forty visitors who want a quick look around and a bite to eat.

card.tourist_group.a_out.text: The bus empties into the restaurant. Cash registers ring.

card.tourist_group.b_out.text: Visitors enjoy the fun contest and tell friends.

card.architect_visit.body.text: A retired course designer is walking your holes with a notebook, and she has opinions.

card.architect_visit.a_out.text: She shares tips that improve how your course plays.

card.architect_visit.b_out.text: She is impressed with your ideas.

card.landmark_press.body.text: A travel show wants to film your landmark for a segment on wonders of the region.

card.landmark_press.a_out.text: The show airs and bookings jump.

card.landmark_press.b_out.text: The show visits a rival attraction instead.

card.comedian_round.body.text: A touring comedian is in town and has asked for a tee time. She tells jokes on every hole.

card.comedian_round.a_out.text: Her group laughs the whole way round. Other golfers gather to listen.

card.comedian_round.b.text: Ask for a photo at the clubhouse

card.comedian_round.b_out.text: She poses with staff and the photo hangs by the door.

card.cartoon_mascot.body.text: The mascot of a fictional baseball team, Captain Hotdog, wants to try mini golf on your putting green.

card.cartoon_mascot.a_out.text: Kids cheer as the mascot misses every putt.

card.chef_demo.body.text: A TV chef from a cooking show has offered to cook a special menu for one evening.

card.chef_demo.a_out.text: The seats sell out and the evening is a hit.

card.chef_demo.b_out.text: Members are thrilled and tell their friends.

card.pro_exhibition.body.text: A fictional touring pro, Dale Fairbanks, offers to play an exhibition round for charity.

card.pro_exhibition.a_out.text: The crowd is big and the day raises money for the club.

card.pro_exhibition.b_out.text: The whole town shows up. Nobody forgets it.

card.influencer_trick.body.text: A video maker known for trick shots wants to film on your course. One of the shots involves the pond.

card.influencer_trick.a_out.text: The video is a hit and viewers plan a visit.

card.influencer_trick.b.text: Say yes but pick the tee

card.influencer_trick.b_out.text: You choose a safe spot. The video is fun and nothing gets lost in the water.

card.puppy_pro.body.text: A dog that fetches golf balls on its own has gone viral, and its owner has brought it to your course.

card.puppy_pro.a_out.text: The dog gets a treat bowl by the first tee. Everyone wants a photo.

card.puppy_pro.b_out.text: The dog and owner go elsewhere.

card.member_complaint_slow.body.text: Members say rounds are taking too long. A group of four spent ten minutes on one putt.

card.member_complaint_slow.a_out.text: Marshals keep the pace flowing. Members notice.

card.member_complaint_slow.b_out.text: A sign helps a little and members appreciate that you listened.

card.member_request_bench.body.text: A member suggests putting benches by the tees so players can rest between holes.

card.member_request_bench.a_out.text: Benches go in. Golfers sit and chat.

card.member_request_bench.b_out.text: A few members donate. The benches are simple but welcome.

card.member_birthday.body.text: One of your longest standing members is turning eighty and plans a round with his grandchildren.

card.member_birthday.a_out.text: He is delighted and the story spreads around the club.

card.member_birthday.b_out.text: A nice gesture that costs little.

card.hole_in_one.body.text: A golfer has holed out from the tee on a par three. He wants everyone in the clubhouse to know.

card.hole_in_one.a_out.text: The clubhouse cheers. The story spreads around town.

card.hole_in_one.b.text: Put a plaque on the tee

card.hole_in_one.b_out.text: Fans of the golfer will see it for years.

card.lost_ball_bin.body.text: The maintenance crew has found hundreds of lost balls in the rough by the pond.

card.lost_ball_bin.a.text: Sell them at the pro shop

card.lost_ball_bin.b.text: Donate them to a junior clinic

card.lost_ball_bin.b_out.text: The kids are thrilled and parents smile.

card.club_champ_dispute.body.text: Two members are arguing over who won a tie at the club championship. Both are quite loud about it.

card.club_champ_dispute.a.text: Play a sudden death putt off

card.club_champ_dispute.a_out.text: The whole club turns up. The winner is crowned by one inch.

card.club_champ_dispute.b_out.text: Both accept, and both grumble in equal measure.

card.ladies_day.body.text: A group of members wants to start a weekly evening league on your quiet holes.

card.ladies_day.a_out.text: The league is a hit and members bring friends.

card.ladies_day.b_out.text: The members find another club night.

card.old_regular_story.title.text: The Tale of the Old Regular

card.old_regular_story.body.text: A regular of thirty years wants to tell the whole club about the time he played with a bird on his shoulder.

card.old_regular_story.a_out.text: The story gets better every time it is told. Members love it.

card.kids_clinic.body.text: A parent group asks if your pro can run a Saturday clinic for children aged six to twelve.

card.kids_clinic.a_out.text: Twenty kids show up with plastic clubs and huge smiles.

card.kids_clinic.b_out.text: Fewer kids join but it is still a hit.

card.locker_room_upgrade.body.text: Members are asking for new lockers, nicer benches, and a real mirror.

card.locker_room_upgrade.a_out.text: Locker room looks brand new. Members are pleased.

card.locker_room_upgrade.b_out.text: Members sigh and the mirror stays cracked.

card.locker_room_upgrade.c_out.text: A fresh coat of paint helps a little.

card.swing_lesson_rush.body.text: Word has spread that the pro shop teaches a great swing tip. Lessons are booked solid.

card.swing_lesson_rush.a_out.text: Two instructors handle the crowd easily.

card.swing_lesson_rush.b_out.text: Lessons are full and the pro is tired.

card.range_challenge.body.text: Golfers are betting bragging rights on who can hit the target flag on the driving range.

card.range_challenge.a_out.text: A free bucket of balls motivates everyone.

card.range_challenge.b_out.text: No prize, just fun. The range is buzzing.

card.greenkeeper_idea.body.text: Your head greenkeeper has a plan to mow the fairways in a striped pattern, like a stadium.

card.greenkeeper_idea.a_out.text: The stripes look fantastic from the tee. Golfers take photos.

card.greenkeeper_idea.b.text: Buy her a better mower first

card.greenkeeper_idea.b_out.text: The new mower cuts cleaner and faster.

card.staff_bake_sale.body.text: The staff want to hold a bake sale to buy a new coffee machine for the break room.

card.staff_bake_sale.a_out.text: You bring a cake. Everyone eats too much and morale soars.

card.staff_bake_sale.b_out.text: The coffee machine is a legend. Staff are delighted.

card.caddie_award.body.text: A starter on the first tee has been praised by three golfers this week for remembering every name.

card.caddie_award.a_out.text: The starter is thrilled. Golfers see the smile on the tee.

card.caddie_award.b_out.text: A framed certificate goes up in the break room.

card.mower_breakdown.body.text: The main fairway mower has stopped with a puff of smoke and a sad noise.

card.mower_breakdown.a_out.text: The mechanic has it working again by afternoon.

card.mower_breakdown.b_out.text: The rental works fine and the course stays tidy.

card.mower_breakdown.c_out.text: The fairways are shaggy for a few days.

card.staff_training_day.body.text: The team asks for a day off the course to learn first aid and customer service.

card.staff_training_day.a_out.text: The team returns sharper and more relaxed.

card.staff_training_day.b_out.text: A quick session helps a little.

card.crew_prank.body.text: The maintenance crew has put a scarecrow in a golf visor next to the sixth green, and it looks very serious.

card.crew_prank.a_out.text: Golfers love him and someone names him Gary.

card.crew_prank.b_out.text: The crew is a little sad but the green looks tidy.

card.new_hire_star.body.text: A young applicant with a big smile and a driving range record wants a job in the pro shop.

card.new_hire_star.a_out.text: She starts Monday and customers adore her.

card.new_hire_star.b.text: Keep her on a waiting list

card.break_room_fix.body.text: The staff sofa has finally given up and now lists to one side like a boat.

card.break_room_fix.b.text: Prop it up with a golf bag

card.insurance_bill.body.text: Your yearly insurance bill has arrived. The agent says there is a cheaper plan with a higher excess.

card.insurance_bill.a_out.text: Nothing changes and you sleep well.

card.insurance_bill.b_out.text: You save a little now and hope for a calm year.

card.tax_refund.body.text: The tax office has found an overpayment. A small refund is on its way.

card.tax_refund.a_out.text: Cash arrives and nothing else is needed.

card.tax_refund.b.text: Spend it on the staff party

card.tax_refund.b_out.text: A pizza night makes the staff very happy.

card.supplier_discount.body.text: The seed and fertilizer supplier will give you a bulk discount if you order early.

card.pipe_burst.body.text: A water pipe near the maintenance shed has burst and there is a small lake where the cart path was.

card.pipe_burst.b_out.text: It holds, mostly. A rumour spreads about the swimming cart.

card.bank_offer.body.text: The local credit union suggests sponsoring your scoreboard for a year in exchange for a logo.

card.bank_offer.a_out.text: The logo goes up and a cheque arrives.

card.bank_offer.b_out.text: They agree to a smaller cheque and a free coffee cart on Saturdays.

card.crowdfund_bunker.body.text: Members have started a jar labelled New Bunker Sand. It already has some coins and a button.

card.crowdfund_bunker.a_out.text: The sand arrives and looks lovely.

card.fair_trade_coffee.body.text: Two coffee suppliers want your business: cheap and bitter, or pricey and delicious.

card.fair_trade_coffee.b_out.text: Costs stay low. Golfers make faces.

card.golf_cart_lease.body.text: A cart company offers to swap your fleet for shiny new electric ones with a lease.

card.golf_cart_lease.a_out.text: The new carts hum quietly and golfers approve.

card.golf_cart_lease.b_out.text: They rattle, but they still run.

card.school_field_trip.body.text: A class of ten year olds is visiting to learn how a golf course works, and the teacher hopes for a tour.

card.school_field_trip.a_out.text: Kids ask a thousand questions, and a few say they want to be greenkeepers.

card.school_field_trip.b_out.text: They love it. The winner gets a sticker.

card.charity_scramble.body.text: The local animal shelter asks to hold a charity scramble on your course.

card.charity_scramble.a_out.text: Volunteers and golfers fill the course. The shelter is thrilled.

card.charity_scramble.b_out.text: The shelter still raises money and you cover your costs.

card.goose_invasion.body.text: A flock of geese has decided the fifth fairway belongs to them. They hiss at anyone who comes near.

card.goose_invasion.a_out.text: A friendly border collie herds them away.

card.goose_invasion.b_out.text: Golfers give them the right of way and take photos.

card.gopher_dance.body.text: Small mounds of dirt are appearing on the greens. You suspect a very clever gopher.

card.gopher_dance.a_out.text: The gopher is moved to a nearby meadow.

card.gopher_dance.b_out.text: Golfers begin leaving him carrots. Putts are a bit bumpy.

card.fireworks_night.body.text: The town wants to launch a fireworks show from your ninth green. Kids and families would attend.

card.fireworks_night.a_out.text: The show is a hit. Some picnic blankets end up on the green.

card.fireworks_night.b_out.text: They find a spot in the park.

card.volunteer_planting.body.text: A local scout troop wants to plant young trees along the back nine.

card.volunteer_planting.a_out.text: A hundred saplings go into the ground and the troop gets a badge.

card.volunteer_planting.b.text: Suggest trees for the edges only

card.volunteer_planting.b_out.text: They plant a neat row and everyone is happy.

card.wildlife_deer.body.text: A family of deer strolls across the first fairway at sunrise. Early golfers stop to watch.

card.wildlife_deer.a_out.text: A little wildlife sign brings smiles.

card.wildlife_deer.b_out.text: Everyone goes home with a story.

card.art_show.body.text: A local painters group asks to hang golf landscape paintings in the clubhouse hall for a month.

card.art_show.a_out.text: Visitors wander in and enjoy the works. A few buy a lunch.

card.town_parade.body.text: The town parade would like to end at your parking lot this year with a marching band.

card.town_parade.a_out.text: Drums, trumpets and a very big tuba. Golfers cheer.

card.night_owl_glow.body.text: A group of youth golfers asks to run a glow ball night on your putting green after sunset.

card.night_owl_glow.a_out.text: Glowing balls flying over the green look magical.

card.night_owl_glow.b_out.text: They pick a sunny Saturday instead.

card.photo_contest.body.text: Members are sharing their best course photos. The winner will get a bucket of range balls.

card.photo_contest.a_out.text: Golfers wander the course looking for the perfect angle.

card.photo_contest.b_out.text: A few photos land on the notice board.

card.rival_challenge.body.text: Golfers from Hollow Pines Golf Club, a fictional neighbour, have challenged your members to a friendly match.

card.rival_challenge.a_out.text: Your members rally. The match ends in a draw and a shared lunch.
